name: Radium Life Tech. Co., Ltd.
summary: Radium Life Tech. Co., Ltd. develops, sells, manages, and leases public housing, building, and industrial zone projects in Taiwan. The company operates through Construction, Leasing, Shopping Mall Business, Resource Circulation, and Others segments. It also engages in the operation of transit stations, hotels, public works, and shopping malls; civil engineering and construction business; investment business; research and development, manufacturing, and sale of health supplements and skin care products; housing and building development and rental business; and reclaimed water construction project business.
